- The handed-over setup is `run_case.py` in your working directory, a self-contained
  Cantera Python script. Hand back the corrected script in the submission and have
  `replay.sh` run it (e.g. `python3 run_case.py`); the evaluator runs `replay.sh`.
- The mechanism files that ship with the installed Cantera distribution are available;
  you can list them from Python. No mechanism is supplied under `/tmp/agent/inputs/`
  for this task -- choosing it is part of the task.
